sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Procedure for authorising expenditure from the Consolidated Fund
maudhui: (1) The President shall give directions to the persons concerned to prepare and submit to the National Assembly in each financial year estimates of the revenue and expenditure of the Government of the United Republic for the following financial year. (2) When the National Assembly has approved the estimates of expenditure (apart from expenditure which is charged upon the Consolidated Fund by this Constitution or any other law) a Bill to be known as an Appropriation Bill shall be introduced in the National Assembly for the purpose of authorizing the issue from the Consolidated Fund of the sums necessary to meet the expenditure. (3) If in respect of any financial year it is found that— (a) the amount appropriated by the Appropriation Act for any purpose is insufficient or that a need has arisen for expenditure for a purpose for which no amount has been appropriated by the Act; or (b) money has been expended for any purpose in excess of the amount appropriated for that purpose by the Appropriation Act or for a purpose for which no amount has been appropriated by the Act, a supplementary estimate showing the sums required or spent shall be submitted to the National Assembly and, when the supplementary estimate has been approved by the National Assembly, a supplementary Appropriation Bill shall be introduced in the National Assembly for the purpose of authorizing the issue of such sums from the Consolidated Fund.
